name: Kawasaki Z1 / KZ900
engine: 903 cc air-cooled DOHC inline four, four carbs
intro: Kawasaki's first big four and a valuable classic. Matching numbers and correct parts matter here.

A-001.title: Identify your bike exactly
A-001.instructions: Record the frame and engine numbers and check that they match the model and year. Watch for reproduction parts sold as original.
A-001.reason: A Z1's value depends heavily on matching numbers and original parts.

add.title: Listen for cam chain noise
add.instructions: Start it cold and listen at the top of the engine. A rattle at idle points at a worn cam chain tensioner.
add.reason: Tensioner wear is a known Z1 issue.

G: Get the tank completely clean inside before you fit rebuilt carbs, or rust will clog them again.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Previous owners
